DOJ release of 5 Jun 2019 (read in the HHS-OIG copy, oig.hhs.gov/fraud/enforcement/opioid-manufacturer-insys-therapeutics-agrees-to-enter-225-million-global-resolution-of-criminal-and-civil-investigations, 2026-10-11; justice.gov answers scripted reads with a bot check): 'Insys will enter into a deferred prosecution agreement with the government, Insys's operating subsidiary will plead guilty to five counts of mail fraud, and the company will pay a $2 million fine and $28 million in forfeiture.' One $30,000,000 payment in the one case (1:19-cr-10191); the registry lists it on both the deferred-prosecution-agreement record and the plea record. Counted once, on the plea row. The $195M civil settlement is not a row here.
